events.text: On behalf of the Warlock Knights of Vaasa, Kardhel Terov swears upon his pact ring that the Knights will not interfere in the affairs of Hulburg or the Hulmasters for exactly 10 years.
The dark angel Sathariel is slain by the deva Jinnaoth Ir'Gadohn
The archmage Tallus of the House of Wonder is killed by the noblewoman Rilyanna Saerfynn in an attempt to complete the ritual of the First Flensing.
Quessahn Uthraebor, a Moon elf warlock, slays Rilyanna Saerfynn to prevent the completion of the First Flensing ritual.

Several human assassins, led by a Cyricist priestess and bolstered by a number of barbazu, attack Lasparhall in Thentia in an attempt to assassinate the rightful ruling family of Hulburg, the Hulmasters. Harmach Grigor Hulmaster is slain, but the rest of the family survives. Shortly before Grigor's funeral, Geran Hulmaster is named Lord Hulmaster.

In retaliation for the attack against his family, Geran Hulmaster travels in secret to Hulburg and secures the aid of Sarth Khul Riizar. Together, the two enter the Temple of the Wronged Prince and defeat Valdarsel, the priest who ordered the Hulmasters' assassinations.

Members of the Cult of Reborn Flame try to awaken the primordial Achazar in the city of Imdolphyn. The ritual is stopped and the cult destroyed thanks to the efforts of a band of brave adventurers and a coalition of powerful individuals from the Windrise Ports.
cites: LFR: Quench the Fire of the Raging God, с. 40–48

events.text: Lycanthropes of the Black Blood tribe led by Bloodeye capture the critical lighthouse near the town of Langmuir on the island of Moray in the Moonshae Isles.
cites: LFR: Darkness Falls over Moray, с. 4

events.text: The Rashemi witch Yaraella is murdered by the Wychlaren Sree and her death made to look like a suicide because Yaraella refused to join the Wychlaren.
Torrin Ironstar is killed after destroying duergar magic that corrupted Moradin's Vein and caused the stoneplague.
The leader of the Dead Rats gang, Toytere, is killed by Sithe during a melee at the gang's headquarters in Luskan.
Sithe, a half-genasi, half-demon sacrifices herself to destroy the demon Scour.

After freeing the town from the tyranny of Rhovann Disarnnyl and his allies, Geran Hulmaster steps down as Lord Hulmaster. Young Natali Hulmaster, Geran's cousin is named the new Harmach, with Kara Hulmaster acting as regent until Natali comes of age.

Danifae Yauntyrr, Chosen of Lolth, appears in Menzoberranzan, preaching Lolth's wish to raise wizards to equal standing with priestesses as Lolth wishes to acquire the divine portfolio of arcane magic. Danifae commands the leaders the city to search for relics of Mystra to fuel Lolth's creation of a new Weave sacred to her. Drow society is strained as many priestesses refuse to contemplate altering the status quo and accuse Danifae of being a fraud.

The Circle of Skulls and the Vigilant Order each attempt to complete the ritual of the First Flensing which would have opened the gates of Hell in Waterdeep. Jinnaoth Ir'Gadohn and his allies stop both groups from finishing the ritual.
A disease known as the Stoneplague begins to infect dwarves in the East Rift region of Faerûn.
The abyssal Fury plague sweeps through Luskan but the demon responsible for the plague is killed by the paladin Kalen Dren.
Avenger ends.
Circle of Skulls
Shadowbane
Eye of Justice
The Gilded Rune
The Darker Road
Assassin guildmaster Pericolo Topolino of Delthuntle is slain by the lich Ebonsoul, whose watery grave he and Spider Parrafin plundered, awakening the lich.
Spider Paraffin (Regis) joins the Grinning Ponies halfling band at Boareskyr Bridge.
King Yarin Frostmantle marries Concettina Delcasio, his seventh wife.
cites: Rise of the King: Hardcover, с. 5,13

events.text: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set (2022)/Dragons of Stormwreck Isle

links.t: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set (2022)/Dragons of Stormwreck Isle

events.text: Bhaal is resurrected when his last two descendants—Abdel Adrian and Viekang—battle. The victor becomes the new god of murder.
cites: Murder in Baldur's Gate: Adventure, с. 4

events.text: Ao begins the Second Sundering, as a way to restore the worlds of Toril and Abeir after the ravages of the Spellplague.
Catti-brie leaves Longsaddle and eventually settles in Bremen in Icewind Dale.

A book called The Scrivener's Tale arrives in Candlekeep when it is donated by Machil Rillyn, a noble from Baldur's Gate, who stipulates that it must be locked away and never read. His wishes are ignored.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Scrivener's Tale, с. 184

events.text: Bruenor Battlehammer attempts to enter Icewind Dale too late in the season. He instead winters at a farmhouse outside Luskan.
Spider Parrafin (Regis) leaves the Grinning Ponies and travels through Luskan before arriving in Icewind Dale and resettling in Lonelywood.

An ambassador of Luruar places blame for the War of the Silver Marches at the feet of Clan Battlehammer during an audience with King Connerad to request military aid for Sundabar. In the same outburst, he blames Citadel Felbarr for the death of Knight-Commander Mindero (despite Mindero's defeat being his own fault).
The dwarven kings of the Silver Marches meet in conclave at Citadel Felbarr and decide that none of them will march to the aid of Luruar.
Sembia attacks the Dalelands and captures Archendale.
Daerlun prepares defenses against a possible Shadovar and Sembian invasion.
Cormyr sends an army to protect the Dalesfolk.
Netheril begins to attack Cormyr's borders, forcing Cormyr into a fight on far reaching fronts.
A large army of orcs and drow, supported by frost giants and white dragons, assaults the Silver Marches in the War of the Silver Marches.
Nesmé was destroyed by a orc horde guided by Tiago Baenre riding the white dragon Arauthator
Sundabar was conquered by a orc army commanded by the warlord Hartusk and renamed Hartusk Keep
Both Rivalen and Brennus Tanthul are killed when the mythallar powering the Shadovar city of Sakkors fails, causing the city to land on top of them.
Berellip Xorlarrin is killed by Artemis Entreri in Q'Xorlarrin.
cites: Night of the Hunter: Hardcover, с. 377

events.text: Bromm, one of the twin kings of Citadel Adbar, is beheaded by Hartusk in the Battle of the Cold Vale.

Knight-Commander Degar Mindero of Silverymoon dies foolishly at the Crossings of the Redrun trying to win glory against a force of orcs six times the size of his own Knights in Silver without calling for reinforcements.
Erevis Cale's son Vasen and his companions Orsin and Gerak are transported to Cania by Drasek Riven where they free Erevis from his one-hundred-year-long magical imprisonment.
After accidentally killing her lover, Hedrun Arnsfirth is banished from the Tribe of the Elk but soon discovers that she is the Chosen of Auril.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide, с. 40,54

events.text: After existing for one hundred years under the noses of the Shadovar, the oracle of the Abbey of the Rose removes the abbey's wards and shortly thereafter the abbey is found by two servants of Mephistopheles, Zeeahd and Sayeed, who mostly destroy the abbey.

Vasen Cale uses the power of Amaunator to sever the god Mask's power from Rivalen, Mephistopheles, and Drasek Riven, with the expectation that Erevis will claim the power. Instead, Riven agrees to accept the burden of divinity and essentially becomes the reborn Mask (or Mask becomes Riven).
Mielikki dissolves Iruladoon, releasing the five people who have been trapped within for the last eighteen years.
Drow wizard Tsabrak Xorlarrin channeled the Darkening upon the Silver Marches under order of Lolth.
Stories begin to travel across the Realms that the gods are bestowing supernatural gifts on a Chosen few.
Amn is swarmed by a plague of locusts.
Iriaebor is devastated by an earthquake.
South Faerûn suffers a terrible drought.
Along the coast of South Faerûn the sea waters begin to recede.
The darkness over Sembia, caused by the Ordulin Maelstrom, starts to dissipate. The sun light not seen in Sembia since the Twilight war begins to show through cracks in the darkness.
The Companions ends.
The Godborn
The Last Threshold ends.
Night of the Hunter
cites: Night of the Hunter: Hardcover, с. 32

events.text: Rise of the King
cites: Rise of the King: Hardcover, с. 78

events.text: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf begins.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 40

events.text: The Battle of Midwinter occurs in the Cold Vale between forces of Citadel Felbarr and Many-Arrows.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 94

events.text: The Battle of Silver Arrows occurs in Luruar between an orc caravan of Many-Arrows and a group of Knights in Silver.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 230

events.text: Warlord Hartusk is killed by Bruenor Battlehammer.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 341–342

events.text: Tos'un Armgo is killed by Drizzt Do'Urden.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 341–342

events.text: Aurbangras is killed.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 341–342

events.text: The War of the Silver Marches ends when Hartusk is defeated and Dark Arrow Keep falls.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 341–342

events.text: Gromph Baenre, with the backing of Jarlaxle and using Drizzt Do'Urden as conduit, dispelled the Darkening, covering the act as a manifestation of the power of Mielikki
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 341–342

events.text: The corpse of Akar Kessel is discovered, risen as a wight.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: A substance known as black ice, a remnant of the power of Crenshinibon, is discovered in Icewind Dale.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: A simple dwarven miner of Clan Battlehammer, one Baerick Hammerstone, is influenced to foment dissent in the Dwarven Valley using black ice.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: Wartsnak is killed by an adventuring party hired to search for the Delimbiyr Bloke.
cites: Scourge of the Sword Coast, с. 42

events.text: Pallidor likely dies when an adventuring party defeats Akar Kessell for good.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: Nalifarn is killed by an adventuring party hired to search for Jekk Ironfist.
cites: Scourge of the Sword Coast, с. 51

events.text: Noyerghu is killed when an adventuring party invades the Phylund Lodge.
cites: Scourge of the Sword Coast, с. 35

events.text: King Harnoth is killed during the War of the Silver Marches.
Franko Olbert is killed in a duel with Tiago Baenre. His corpse is then eaten by the white dragon Arauthator.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover

events.text: Balor is accosted by the goddess Lolth, who then allies with Balor's greatest rival, the balor Errtu. Lolth destroys his minions, poisons him, and entraps him in a web cocoon.
Darrondar Gweth is visited by "Alwern" (in truth, the disguised rakshasa Nadir).
Vaelish Gant, a member of the Arcane Brotherhood, attempts to become Speaker of Bryn Shander by undermining Duvessa Shane.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: Hedrun Arnsfirth becomes the Chosen of Auril.
cites: Legacy of the Crystal Shard: Campaign Guide

events.text: The War of the Silver Marches results in the destruction of the Orc nation Kingdom of Many-Arrows.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 25

events.text: Eleint 24, Bjami Tengervaald leads an attack of Hedrun Arnsfirth's army against Elk warriors, killing or capturing many of them.
Orcs besiege Silverymoon.
Autumn: Dark Arrow Keep is completely destroyed and disassembled.
The Bedine tribes rebell against Netheril as the Netherese spread their forces thin against Cormyr and the Dalelands.
The Netherese trade ground in their conflicts with the Cormyrians in Cormyr and Sembia.
The Dales descend into chaos and war.
Jütti Merliss of the Tribe of the Wolf leads an assault on the town of Good Mead.
cites: Dungeon 220: King of the Wolves, с. 52

events.text: Drought continues in South Faerûn.
The Great Rain begins over the Sea of Fallen Stars at the start of autumn.
Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf ends.
cites: Vengeance of the Iron Dwarf: Hardcover, с. 92

events.text: Archmage

King Connerad Brawnanvil officially steps down from the throne of Mithral Hall to become Bruenor Battlehammer's General in his march on Gauntlgrym. Having declared his General Dagnabbet as his heir the previous year, Dagnabbet becomes the first Queen of Mithral Hall.
King Foril Obarskyr dies in his sleep.
cites: Fire in the Blood: Hardcover 2014, с. 252

events.text: The Shadovar sack Marsember.
King Irvil Obarskyr dies.
cites: Fire in the Blood: Hardcover 2014, с. 443

events.text: Crown prince Baerovus Obarskyr abdicates the throne in favor of his sister Raedra Obarskyr, who is officially crowned a tenday later.
Gromph Baenre summons Demogorgon to the Underdark.

Enlil returnes to Toril and manifests in Djerad Thymar in the shape of a Dragonborn, thereby choosing the race as his new protégés. Gilgeam and his people return from Abeir to Toril and immediately move against Djerad Thymar to reclaim the lands of Unther from Tymanther, starting the First Tymanther-Unther War.
cites: Ashes of the Tyrant: Hardcover, с. 411–412, 414–415, 420–421

events.text: Enlil and Gilgeam return to Toril.
The last battle of the Mulhorandi rebellion starts.
cites: Ashes of the Tyrant: Hardcover, с. 161

events.text: The fleet of Turmish engages the pirate fleet of Evendur Highcastle, emerging victorious thanks in part to Anton Marivaldi.
The Shadovar besieges Arabel and Suzail until Nightal 1 when both sieges are broken and many shadovar fall.
Prince of Shade Yder Tanthul is killed by the Chosen of Helm Kleef Kenric
Vanquisher Tarhun and a commander of the Lance Defenders, Ophinshtalajiir Sepideh, are killed by a maurezhi demon.
cites: Ashes of the Tyrant: Hardcover, с. 403, 433, 437, 467

events.text: Gabulla was possessed by the pit fiend Baazka and, under his manipulation, convinced her leader Shorg to invade the village of Julkoun, following the suggestion of one of the Red Wizards of Thay.
cites: Scourge of the Sword Coast, с. 69

events.text: Valmorba opens the Lower City Mortuary, servicing the Lower City Graveyard in Baldur's Gate.
Chauntea drops several earthmotes in the flooded Arrabar River to give her followers enough time to bring in the harvest.
Helm resumes his position among the gods

Nobanion, still under Malar's control, is tasked to capture Stedd Whitehorn, the boy Chosen of Lathander, but Stedd and his companions heal him of his corruption by blue fire. He returns to his natural state, and introduces himself to Stedd and his companions; in his reinstated form, he is no longer under Malar's control. He guides the young Chosen through the wilds of Gulthandor, parting ways just before Stedd and company enter Turmish.
The Great Rain falls for several months, slowly refilling the Sea of Fallen Stars which revitalizes former port cities and the island of Ilighon.
Earthmotes begin falling from the sky.
Plaguelands begin disappearing.
The Underchasm closes by the power of Grumbar.
Harpers free the Chosen captives of Netheril from their prison in the Lost Peaks.
Stedd Whitehorn heals Lady Cindermoon of her mental degradation, thereby revitalizing the Emerald Enclave.
In a surprise move, King Emerus Warcrown declares his abdication from the throne of Citadel Felbarr, naming Parson Glaive his successor.
Archmage ends.
Ashes of the Tyrant
Fire in the Blood
The Adversary ends.
The Devil You Know begins.
The Reaver
The Sentinel
Starlight Enclave prologue.
The First Tymanther-Unther War ends with a decisive Tymantheran victory.
The War Wizard Ilstan Nyaril sacrifices his life to allow the return of the god Azuth.

The monks of Candlekeep are revealed to have several agents of other groups among their number, including Netherese, Red Wizards, and members of the Moonstars, including Laeral and Alustriel Silverhand. When the Netherese monks attack their fellows, the others reveal themselves and battle for control of the library. Elminster deceives the Netherese into believing that he is Telamont Tanthul and Larloch convinces him to use the wards of Candlekeep to bolster the new Weave but then betrays Elminster by stealing the power for himself.
Hadrhune is killed again. Telamont forbids his resurrection, owing to the potential interference of spirits trapped in the new Weave.
Dove Falconhand succumbs to injuries sustained while rallying the baelnorn of Myth Drannor to come out of their tombs and defend their city.

The Srinshee sacrifices herself to wrest the stolen Weave energy from Larloch and Telamont and bolster Mystra's new Weave. She also teleports Ilsevele Miritar and Fflar Melruth to safety in Semberholme.
Prince Vattick Tanthul of Shade is killed by Dove Falconhand.
Elminster assassinates Telamont Tanthul.

Marpenoth 9 to Marpenoth 13: The flying city of Shade moves directly against Myth Drannor. Telamont Tanthul drains the energies of Myth Drannor's mythal in order to turn the new Weave into a Shadow Weave for his mistress. Larloch strikes against the elves in the confusion and the Srinshee appears to defend them. Shade eventually crashes into Myth Drannor but a hastily erected ward protects the Tree of Souls from the impact.
Shar chooses Telamont Tanthul to be her new Chosen.
The gods Asmodeus and Azuth separate and become individual gods again. Nanna-Sin is resurrected, though as an immortal instead of as a god, as part of a covenant struck between Enlil and Asmodeus.

The Second Sundering ends. Many deities previously thought gone have managed to make a comeback by the conclusion of this event: Mystra, Helm, Mask, Lathander, Bhaal, Eilistraee,, and Vhaeraun are known examples.
Abeir begins to re-separate from Toril in the spring, heralding volcanic eruptions and earthquakes. The process is completed by the fall.
Rumors abound that chasms created by the Spellplague are disappearing.
People and lands thought lost during the Spellplague begin to reappear.
The winter of this year is longer than any other recorded in the Realms.
The Court of the Three, a secret society made up of shadovar survivors, is established in one of the more intact fortresses of the Citadel of the Raven.
cites: Forging the Realms: After the Fall

events.text: Larloch shatters the minds of many of Shade's finest arcanists, among them Prince Aglarel Tanthul.
Vangerdahast is returned to human form by Mystra.

Lord Viallis Yellowcrest of Waterdeep ritualistically murders his family and servants in order to contact an entity called Gaernoo. Viallis then leaves Waterdeep for Greenfast, where he founds the Burnt Tongue Cult dedicated to Gaernoo.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Sarah of Yellowcrest Manor, с. 102

events.text: Evermeet, Lantan, and Nimbral (all nations thought lost to the Spellplague) send ships to the mainland, along the Sword Coast and the coast of the Shining South.
Halruaan skyships are spotted throughout south Faerûn.
Hardy settlers from the cities of Neverwinter and Waterdeep begin resettling the ruins of Phandalin.
cites: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set: Lost Mine of Phandelver, с. 14

events.text: Hero
Maestro
The Devil You Know ends.
The Herald

Anivar Daoran, Lord Protector of Phlan, dies in what appears to be a construction accident. Ector Brahms, Knight-Commander of the Black Fist, is appointed Lord Regent of the Cinnabar Throne. The city soon descends into anarchy, and Brahms declares martial law.
cites: Phlan during the Tyranny of Dragons

events.text: In Cormyr, in the mansion of Sardasper Halaunt, many archmages killed each other for possession of the mythical Lost Spell. Among the casualties were Shaaan, Maraunth Torr, Calathlarra from the Twisted Rune, the Harper Alastra Hathwinter, Laragunt of Threskel, Yusendre, and Skouloun from the Nimbral Lords.
What remains of the Netherese battle the Bedine for control of Anauroch.
A battle between the Netherese and Bedine upon the Memory Spire (an ancient phaerimm tomb) awakens dormant phaerimm.
The solstices and equinoxes do not align correctly starting with the spring equinox falling on Greengrass.
As the long winter of the previous year ends, it pushes back the start of all other seasons.
Anauroch is magically drained by newly awakened phaerimm, again reducing it to a desert.
Abeir fully separates from Toril.
An earthquake strikes Mount Hotenow as Maegera attempts to break free from its bonds below Gauntlgrym.
Faithful prayers to the gods for understanding and mercy appear to go unheard.
The gods only seem to send messages through their Chosen.
The Alliance of Luruar begins to fall apart.
Sembia is now free of Thultanthar and its city-states form a tentative alliance with each other to restore their nation's sovereignty.
Aside from a handful of minor settlements throughout Faerûn, the Netherese empire is no longer a regional power.
Boundless
Relentless: Chapters 7–13, 21–31
Spellstorm
Timeless
The town of Greenest comes under attack from the Cult of the Dragon.

The Green Dragon Mask is recovered from the lair of Claugiyliamatar in Kryptgarden Forest. Old Gnawbone herself was injured while blows were struck against Thay, the Cult of the Dragon and the Zartruss hobgoblin clan.

Vorgansharax attacks and conquers Phlan with the aid of an army of dragon cultists that boil up from beneath the city. The dragon erects a cage of magical thorns around Phlan, sealing it off from the outside to ensure the dragon's dominance.

Unther tries to invade Tymanther for a second time, but the Untherite navy is unable to overcome the dragon turtle that protects Djerad Kethendi. Mulhorand fortify its borders with the two countries to avoid the conflict to spill in his lands.

Xardorok Sunblight plots an invasion of Icewind Dale, and unleashes his chardalyn dragon on Ten Towns. The towns of Dougan's Hole and Good Mead are razed by the dragon before it is destroyed while attacking Easthaven.
cites: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, с. 5
Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 111

events.text: Ector Brahms is killed by Vorgansharax and his body destroyed.
Kendrick Rielsbarrow, town speaker of Good Mead, is killed by a verbeeg maurauder.
cites: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, с. 72

events.text: Lord Ao decrees the end of the Era of Upheaval.
The gods begin to talk to their followers again, but their influence is subtler than before. New priesthoods arose to interpret the new behavior of the gods.

In Flamerule, Eilistraee and Vhaeraun fully reacquired the power that they had possessed before 1375 DR. They held their own old portfolios, and were separate entities (Eilistraee was still a drow goddess, as were most of their followers--not dark elves, despite a spell cast by Q'arlynd Melarn in 1379 DR), but they managed to reach a reciprocal understanding, respect, and even a truce (although their followers still skirmished often). Both Eilistraee and Vhaeraun personally announced their return to the Realms, manifesting through their avatars to their followers.

The seasons continue to start and end later than normal as a result of the environmental chaos of the separation of Abeir from Toril in the prior years. While some fear this change is permanent, most expect the seasons to return to normal in the coming years.
In Icewind Dale, the nonstop two-year winter of Auril's Everlasting Rime ends.
cites: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, с. 5

events.text: The rebellion against the rule of Vorgansharax, having failed, causes Phlan's refugees to flee to Mulmaster.
Severin Silrajin, under orders from Tiamat, attempts to create the Mask of the Dragon Queen to free her from the Nine Hells and collect a treasure hoard that she might deem worthy.
The dragon Throstulgrael achieves dracolichdom.
Tyranthraxus returns to the Realms through a newly unearthed pool of radiance and possesses the body of Vorgansharax.

Ammalia and Victoro Cassalanter sign a pact with Asmodeus trading their children's souls in exchange for financial prosperity. Their eldest son, Osvaldo, is immediately taken, his body transformed into a chain devil.
The adventurer Harko Swornhold is exiled from Waterdeep for attempting to bribe a magistrate.

Arrant Quill, a heroic bard in service to the Harpers, is corrupted by a magic item imbued with the power of Cyric, causing him to turn against his old allies. His Harper friends respond by imprisoning him in a demiplane concealed within a book called The Curious Tale of Wisteria Vale while they attempt to research a cure. The book is donated to Candlekeep that same year for safekeeping and for access to the library's knowledge.

links.t: The Curious Tale of Wisteria Vale

cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Curious Tale of Wisteria Vale, с. 147–148,155

events.text: The Harpers form a pact with the fey of Kryptgarden forest serving King Witchthorn, an Unseelie lord.
A variety of new priesthoods spring up across the Realms to discern the will of the gods in the wake of the Second Sundering.
Three merchant ships are mysteriously obliterated near Luskan, prompting Jarlaxle and his allies to investigate.
cites: One-Eyed Jax: A Forgotten Realms Adventure

events.text: The Lantanese submarine Scarlet Marpenoth is launched.

The nautiloid Id Ascendant crashes in southern Icewind Dale, stranding a crew of two gnome ceremorphs and three gnome squidlings, as well as a complement of otherworldly pets and living experiments, in the icy region.
cites: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden, с. 132–137

events.text: Menzoberranzan descends into civil war.

A mind flayer attempts to take over the duergar city of Gracklstugh using Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V's madness as an advantage, even dominating the red dragon Themberchaud, but was thwarted by a group of adventurers.
Starlight Enclave
Glacier's Edge
Lolth's Warrior

After the cults of Elemental Evil slip dozens of devastation orbs into Mulmaster, the city's harbor is destroyed when one is successfully detonated in the sewers, despite running battles between cultists and agents of the Five factions that resulted in the rest being prevented from doing significant damage.
The mind flayers Chishinix, Hashutu, and Voalsh work to transform Phandalin's inhabitants into mind flayers on behalf of their "god" Ilvaash.
cites: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk, с. 147

events.text: The returned Eilistraee, is seen dancing with, and speaking to, mortals up and down the Sword Coast. In particular, she appears under the walls of Waterdeep, leading many of her followers there.
Many deities no longer grant resurrection spells, except to rare exceptions.
Mystra imposes heavy restrictions on the use of mind-reading and mind-reaming magic, especially when used on other spellcasters.

The latest incarnation of the Cult of Elemental Evil rises as a union of four cults when the prophets, the moon elf Aerisi Kalinoth, leader of the Cult of the Howling Hatred; the tiefling Vanifer, leader of the Cult of the Eternal Flame; the medusa Marlos Urnrayle, leader of the Cult of the Black Earth; and the human Gar Shatterkeel, leader of the Cult of the Crushing Wave, take possession of the elemental weapons, the spear Windvane, the dagger Tinderstrike, the war pick Ironfang, and the trident Drown, form the Fane of the Eye located beneath the ruins of the ancient dwarven fortress-city of Tyar-Besil in the Sumber Hills of the Dessarin Valley in order to summon the Princes of Elemental Evil.

After months of operating in secret, the Cult of the Black Earth attacks a delegation from the city of Mirabar bound for Waterdeep, attracting the attention of the Lords' Alliance, as well as the Harpers, the Order of the Gauntlet, the Emerald Enclave, and even the Zhentarim, who all send agents into the Dessarin Valley.
Due to the actions of adventurers in Red Larch, the Believers, a secret cabal that runs the town, is publicly exposed, resulting in their losing control of the town and Red Larch electing a mayor.
Oreioth, a human necromancer from a noble family in Baldur's Gate, is discovered practicing his dark art in Lance Rock, having taken the title "Lord of Lance Rock".
Jarlaxle acquires the submarine Scarlet Marpenoth in Lantan.
The Blackstaff of Waterdeep, Vajra Safahr, seeks the meaning of the current year's name.

The dwarven Rockseeker brothers face difficulties after discovering the legendary mines of the Phandelver's Pact (the location of which was lost centuries ago), and they call upon adventurers to help.
cites: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set: Lost Mine of Phandelver

events.text: Iarno Albrek of the Lords' Alliance betrays his faction and becomes the leader of the Redbrand Ruffians after entering Phandalin.
cites: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk, с. 34

events.text: Followers of Eilistraee travel to Waterdeep after the Dark Dancer is seen dancing under the walls of the city. They seek the support of the Harper representative Remallia Haventree to create a forest-glade to Eilistraee in the Field Ward, destroyed by dragons in 1485 DR. Remallia accepts their request, and the new temple is allowed.
The Blacktongue tribe of bullywugs are forcibly transported to the Slitherswamp level of Undermountain by Halaster.
cites: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage, с. 109

events.text: Aerisi Kalinoth, Marlos Urnrayle, Vanifer, and Gar Shatterkeel are killed by adventurers, destroying the Cult of Elemental Evil as their followers scatter and go into hiding.
Oreioth is killed by adventurers.
The dwarven adventurers of Falkir's Fist die within Muiral's Gauntlet, just before they reached a portal to escape Undermountain.
cites: Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage, с. 140

events.text: Tharden Rockseeker is killed by Nezznar, right after he enters Wave Echo Cave.
cites: Dungeons & Dragons Starter Set: Lost Mine of Phandelver, с. 44

events.text: In the spring, many households in Baldur's Gate are afflicted by shellfish poisoning.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 178

events.text: The ancient dwarven fortress-city of Tyar-Besil, stronghold of the dwarven kingdom of Besilmer, is rediscovered by adventurers battling the Cult of Elemental Evil. Once the cult is beaten, dwarves slowly begin to reclaim the city.

In the spring, a pale and silent murderer dressed in ancient patriar attire begins attacking the common people of Baldur's Gate's Outer City. Its appearance coincides with a visit to the city by a mysterious relative of the Bormul family, who left several trinkets in the family crypts.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 178–179

events.text: Princes of the Apocalypse
Lost Mine of Phandelver
Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

events.text: Death Masks
A conflict between the Xanathar's Thieves' Guild and the Zhentarim in Waterdeep escalates into a street war.
A skirmish between members of the Zhentarim and the Gralhund family becomes known by Waterdhavian broadsheets as the Gralhund Villa Bloodbath.

The city of Elturel is pulled into the first layer of the Nine Hells, Avernus, leaving nothing behind but a crater. The city is saved by brave heroes and returns to its former location before the end of the year.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 5–8
Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn, с. 81

events.text: The library of Candlekeep is attacked by the Order of the Immortal Lotus, who kill two acolytes and steal dangerous secrets by tearing pages from The Book of Inner Alchemy.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Book of Inner Alchemy, с. 160–161

events.text: A clone of Manshoon appears in Waterdeep and strives to exert control over the local Zhentarim from his base at Kolat Towers.

Waterdeep's City Watch is overwhelmed by violence throughout the city, leading to factions stepping in to help fight gangs and monsters, including the Emerald Enclave, the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, and even the Zhentarim.

Cultists of the Dead Three based out of the Hamhocks Slaughterhouse in Baldur's Gate's outer city go on a murder spree throughout the city. They dump the bodies of their victims behind the Smilin' Boar.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 197
Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 11,20

events.text: The Amberdune Pack of jackalweres is driven from their home in Amn when their leader, Nidalia, is slain. After a few months, they hatch a scheme to pay to resurrect her in Baldur's Gate by creating and selling gingwatzims disguised as valuable books.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Mazfroth's Mighty Digressions, с. 27

events.text: The Scarlet Sash, an order of wereravens dedicated to stealing potent magic items away from evil individuals, acquires a desecrated Figurine of Orcus before it can be sold at an auction.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Book of the Raven, с. 37,44

events.text: The Burnt Tongue Cult begins kidnapping travelers along the Trade Way between Waterdeep and Daggerford.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Sarah of Yellowcrest Manor, с. 105–106

events.text: A cult known as the Livestock hatch a scheme to launch one of the towers of Candlekeep into wildspace. When their secret is betrayed by one of their own, they move up their timetable and cause an earthquake.

The Harpers devise a means to cure their former member, Arrant Quill, of evil corruption, but must first confront him within the demiplane in which they trapped him three years prior. At the same time, a beholder named Renekor dreams itself into the demiplane and imprisons Arrant.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Curious Tale of Wisteria Vale, с. 148

events.text: The Cult of the Absolute rises, in which followers worship the Absolute, a so-called god that they believe is destined to take over the world, leading to a new order where True Souls rule above all else.
Victorio and Ammalia Cassalanter seek to buy their way out of their infernal contract with Asmodeus in order to save the souls of their children, Elzerina and Terenzio.

Agents of the Zhentarim and of Xanathar's Thieves' Guild vie to kidnap Renaer Neverember as they believe he knows how to use the Stone of Golorr. They accidentally take his lookalike, Floon Blagmaar, instead.
The ghost of a girl named Sarah manifests in Candlekeep alongside her journal, which seems to detail disturbing information about Lord Viallis Yellowcrest of Waterdeep.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Sarah of Yellowcrest Manor, с. 100–101

events.text: A young bronze dragon named Zelifarn takes up residence in the Waterdeep Harbor.
Jarlaxle seeks leverage over members of the Lords' Alliance in hopes of pressuring them to admit Luskan onto their council.
Dagult Neverember sends agents to Waterdeep in hopes of reclaiming the half a million gold dragons he embezzled during his tenure as Open Lord.

Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard of Baldur's Gate disappears during a diplomatic visit to Elturgard when he is taken to Avernus along with Elturel. This leaves the Flaming Fist without a leader, so Duke Dillard Portyr recalls his niece, Liara Portyr, from Chult in order to take command of the mercenary army.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 10

events.text: Upon his return to the Prime Material Plane, Grand Duke Ulder Ravengard is captured by Absolute cultists and taken to Moonrise Towers, where he is infected with an illithid tadpole and becomes the puppet of Enver Gortash. He announces Gortash as the first Archduke of Baldur's Gate.
A flood of refugees arrive in Baldur's Gate from Elturgard following the disappearance of Elturel. In response, the city bars its outer gates against them.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 10
Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 11

events.text: A group of yuan-ti followers of the Scaled Mother leave Chult and arrive peacefully at a grippli village in the Cloak Wood on the Sword Coast, where they begin excavating what they believe to be a temple to their deity. They are shortly followed by a much more murderous group of yuan-ti, who capture the first group and seize control of the grippli village.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Book of Cylinders, с. 92

events.text: The mummy lord Valin Sarnaster of the House of the All-Seeing Orb in Tashluta schemes to usurp Savras. She enacts a plan to transform her enemies into canopic golems to prevent them from interfering.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Canopic Being, с. 172–174

events.text: The saprophytic plague ravages the Sword Coast, causing disease and famine on a massive scale.
Dalakhar, a rock gnome in service of Lord Dagult Neverember of Neverwinter, is killed by a fireball in Trollskull Alley in Waterdeep.
Duke Dillard Portyr of Baldur's Gate is assassinated. He gets better.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 192

events.text: A series of individuals go missing from Candlekeep, including a visiting sage named Matreous, an acolyte named Falthrax Loderr, and a scholar named Mayastan Sadaar.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: The Joy of Extradimensional Spaces, с. 17
Candlekeep Mysteries: The Price of Beauty, с. 75–76
Candlekeep Mysteries: The Canopic Being, с. 170

events.text: In Baldur's Gate, several merchants and patriars attempt to strong-arm the owners of the shop Distant Shores into selling their business.
cites: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus, с. 179

events.text: A magical book called Shemshime's Bedtime Rhyme causes a curse to spread in Candlekeep, causing all those infected to be unable to resist humming a specific nursery rhyme. The Avowed quarantine the cursed individuals beneath the House of Rest.
cites: Candlekeep Mysteries: Shemshime's Bedtime Rhyme, с. 61–62

events.text: A pair of bedine nomads—Pesh and Shamir—discover the Sapphire Sentinel not far from Haruun.

events.text: Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus
Candlekeep Mysteries
Baldur's Gate III
A horde of goblins from the Marching Mountains attacks Calimshan. At the request of Sultana Songal, 20,000 Kochar riders from Calimshan's Central Steppes aid in the fight against them.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 139–140

events.text: The Order of the Stout Half-Pint acquires the Silent Sound Lighthouse north of Neverwinter as a base of operations.

In Waterdeep, Hardyn Glorjarn takes over ownership of the office building shared by Demra Samdro's Best Beds, Erro Alhandrar's Nets, Laskalan's Lamps and Lanterns, and Tantra Jaressra's Fine Gowns. That same year, she moves into its uppermost floor.
A mysterious cabal known as The Six discover a piece of the Orrery of the Wanderer. They begin searching for additional pieces and plotting how to use it to conquer Faerûn.
A group of adventurers led by Caerhan Coalsmith discover a piece of an artifact known as the Orrery of the Wanderer. Over several months, the artifact's dark magic kills almost all of the party.
A mysterious cabal known as The Six launches attacks against Acquisitions Incorporated in the Sword Coast North.
Ongoing conflicts escalate between the Xanathar's Thieves' Guild and the Zhentarim in Waterdeep amidst power grabs by groups like Acquisitions Incorporated.
Forces from the Far Realm attack the town of Red Larch.
The red dragon Balagos captures and maims the bronze dragon Ixolothingeir, and forces him to defend a secondary treasure hoard in the Starspire Mountains.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn, с. 70

events.text: The splinter sect of the Zhentarim led by Manshoon seeks to solidify its power in the Sword Coast. The Zhent operative in Phandalin, Halia Thornton, is killed and replaced by a Manshoon loyalist named Sharna Quirstiron, who plots to subvert the town's leaders.
Waterdeep's Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters goes on strike, leaving the city dark and dangerous at night.
The Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr, mobilizes the Gray Hands to determine the intentions of the green dragon Kofutacti, who was spotted above the Sea of Swords near Waterdhavian shipping lanes.
The town of Phandalin holds its first mayoral election. The candidates are Harbin Wester and Sildar Hallwinter.
Famous Waterdhavian actress Tystanya Creed disappears upon leaving the theater following a performance.

A member of the nobility of Waterdeep in the Southern Ward survives an assassination attempt when a bodyguard injures the assailant. A bounty is offered for the would-be assassin's capture, but the only description given is that of a female half-elf with a wounded shoulder.
Caerhan Coalsmith dies while trying to destroy the Orrery of the Wanderer.
Halia Thornton, proprietor of the Phandalin Miner's Exchange and a member of the Town Council of Phandalin, is killed in secret. Many believe she has instead left town without saying why.
An earthquake rocks the city of Waterdeep. It is caused by the activation of a powerful shrine, dedicated to That-Which-Endures, located in a tunnel system deep beneath the city.
Tall, black-cloaked skeletal figures are spotted at night in Waterdeep's City of the Dead.
A murderer in Waterdeep's North Ward attacks victims in broad daylight, severing their heads and feet. The feet are then taken by the killer.
One of the Walking Statues of Waterdeep appears to start crying. Some see this as a sign of great misfortune, others as a sign of good luck, and others simply blame the humidity.

Queen Anais Rhindaun of Tethyr dies of old age.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn, с. 70

events.text: Ysabel Linden becomes Queen of Tethyr.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn, с. 70

events.text: Ringreemeralxoth is slain by the beholder Sersentrych.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn, с. 69

events.text: A slaad egg is found in the mud of the Shaengarne River at Bremen.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 103

events.text: A contingent of the Flaming Fist launches an attack on murderous Dead Three cultists at the Hamhocks Slaughterhouse in Baldur's Gate's Outer City, bringing them to justice.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 208

events.text: Sahuagin led by Baron Skurr prepare to raid Baldur's Gate to recover a sacred conch. Sahuagin begin covert attacks around the docks, launched from an abandoned ship called the Fearsome Grimace.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 207
Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 222

events.text: A long-frozen beholder emerges from the mines of Termalaine in Icewind Dale and goes on a destructive rampage.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 127

events.text: Szass Tam, having lost total control over the Council of Zulkirs, plots to destroy them and reestablish himself as sole ruler of Thay using a ritual known as Malefice Mortum. His plans are discovered by spies of Zulkir Xelnene Thrul, who launches Operation Deadfall to thwart him.
Krazbrax Nixel, who requests on his deathbed that adventurers travel through the time gate at Fool's Needle to prove that it leads to ancient Netheril.
Statues representing five "forgotten" deities awaken and cause havoc in Calimport's Temple of a Thousand. These include the Hukh, Korus, Motanwe, Nimbus, and Sholoban.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 157

events.text: The Rusting appears in the harbor and along the coast near Kythyss on the southern tip of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 187

events.text: An outbreak of the Shaking Plague strikes Scardale Town's docks and slums.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 35

events.text: The Guild takes control of the Hamhocks Slaughterhouse, turning it into their largest operation outside of Baldur's Gate's Lower City.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 208

events.text: The Guild scrambles to eliminate inventor Flurn Eightspoke after he unknowingly creates a clockwork copy of the mind of one of their informants.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 224

events.text: A cult of Auril led by Ice-Knife Nymetra operates out of Caer-Dineval and begins to capture inhabitants of Easthaven to sacrifice to their goddess. Easthaven's sheriff, Markham Southwell, takes notice after the disappearance of a fisherman named Bott Witters.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 110–111,124

events.text: A Zhentarim caravan transporting stolen goods from Bryn Shander to Targos is attacked by cultists from Dougan's Hole.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 126

events.text: Members of the patriar Eomane family host a lavish party with the intention of killing the guests for the glory of Bhaal.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 223

events.text: The specter of the ogre warlord Bonegnasher grows restless in the Tomb of Damara, and kidnaps the Silverstar family from Shadowdale Town after Sara Silverstar finds the key to the Tomb.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 86

events.text: Vargrazt the Wretch proposes to purify the remains of the crashed chardalyn dragon in Easthaven via a ritual.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 125

events.text: The lamia Selim plots to steal a brazier of commanding fire elementals from the Calishite merchant Shezar Han.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 156

events.text: The performer Braelin Wyngard is captured by a night hag while exploring a wandering isle near the Moonshae Isles.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 188

events.text: The gnome scholar Vigglestern discovers a time gate leading to the city of Conch during the last years of the ancient Netherese empire.
The Dales Council seeks capable new leaders to rebuild Freedale.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 87

events.text: High King Derid Kendrick of the Moonshae Isles seeks a formal peace treaty with Thuven Moltenbeard, the fire giant king of Oman's Isle. The High King sends emissaries, but a fomorian known as Ulrik Fellwhisper works to sabotage the talks.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 189

events.text: Jarl Olfsvenn of Norland learns the location of the lost ring of Cymrych Hugh, and seeks to acquire it for High King Derid Kendrick.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 189

events.text: Followers of Bane who had infiltrated Baldur's Gate's Parliament of Peers push for the parliament to seize greater control over commerce, defense, and taxation from the Council of Four. This "Shadow Parliament" works to silence politicians who oppose their scheme.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 225

events.text: Myrna Nor and Powell Niccam identify the lost library of Lethchauntos in the Dalelands as the likely location of The Nathlum.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn: The Lost Library of Lethchauntos, с. 227

events.text: Monster attacks along the edge of Cormanthor suddenly increase in frequency. Foresters believe the creatures to be coming out of the ruined Temple of Transmutation in Myth Drannor.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 88

events.text: Aberrations and undead begin attacking any who approach the Dallabad Oasis in the Calim Desert.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 158

events.text: The Calimemnon Crystal reappears as a "shooting star" that lands in the Calim Desert near Calimport. It is sought by both the marid Sultan Biha Babir of Maran Saya and by agents of Sultana Songal of Calimshan.
cites: Forgotten Realms: Adventures in Faerûn, с. 159

Breezy Do'Urden completes her training in the Way of Shadow at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose.
The Companions of the Hall travel to Icewind Dale with the intent to build a portal that will link Kelvin's Cairn to Gauntlgrym.

Dawnbringer chapters 6-9.

Forces led by Sanwar Beguine and the vampire Saestra attack Jadaren Hold near Erlkazar.
